% .github/tex/layout.tex - packages, title block and bibliography style for each document class.
% Classes: IEEEtran (conference and journal), ieeeconf (CDC/ACC), elsarticle, llncs, acmart and article.
% Of the files in .github/, only this one is meant to be edited for a paper. For another class, add a branch below
% that sets \title, \author, \paperfront and \paperbibstyle as that class requires.
\makeatletter
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\@ifclassloaded{acmart}{}{\usepackage{amssymb}}      % acmart's fonts already define these symbols; amssymb would clash
\@ifclassloaded{ieeeconf}{\let\proof\relax\let\endproof\relax}{}   % remove ieeeconf's proof so that amsthm defines it
\@ifclassloaded{llncs}{}{\usepackage{amsthm}}         % llncs defines its own proof environment
\usepackage{graphicx,wrapfig,needspace,booktabs,array}
\@ifpackageloaded{natbib}{}{\usepackage{cite}}        % elsarticle loads natbib
\@ifpackageloaded{hyperref}{\hypersetup{hidelinks}}{\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}}   % acmart loads it
\usepackage[capitalize,noabbrev]{cleveref}

\@ifundefined{proposition}{\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}}{}
\crefname{proposition}{Proposition}{Propositions}

% \arxivref{label} prints "Appendix A" in the arXiv version and "Appendix A of [5]" in the others, where
% [5] is \cite{arxiv}. The others read the labels from refs/extended_labels.tex, which the build copies
% from the .aux file of the arXiv version, and store each one as ext-<label>. The file is .tex, not .aux,
% because Overleaf drops *.aux files.
\ifversion{arxiv}
  {\newcommand{\arxivref}[1]{Appendix~\ref{#1}}}
  {\newcommand{\arxivref}[1]{Appendix~\ref*{ext-#1} of~\cite{arxiv}}%
   {\def\newlabel#1#2{\expandafter\gdef\csname r@ext-#1\endcsname{#2}}%
    \InputIfFileExists{refs/extended_labels}{}{\InputIfFileExists{../refs/extended_labels}{}{}}}}

% Title block and bibliography style of each class.
\newcommand{\paperabstract}{\begin{abstract}\input{sections/abstract}\end{abstract}}
\@ifclassloaded{IEEEtran}{%                         % IEEE conference and IEEE Transactions
  \title{\papertitle}
  \ifCLASSOPTIONconference \author{\IEEEauthorblockN{\paperauthors}\IEEEauthorblockA{\paperaffiliation}}
  \else \author{\paperauthors\thanks{The authors are with \paperaffiliation.}}\fi
  \newcommand{\paperfront}{\maketitle\paperabstract}
  \newcommand{\paperbibstyle}{IEEEtran}
}{\@ifclassloaded{ieeeconf}{%                        % IEEE CDC / ACC: letter paper, 10 pt
  \IEEEoverridecommandlockouts\overrideIEEEmargins   % \thanks allowed; margins of the CDC/ACC call
  \title{\LARGE\bf \papertitle}
  \author{\paperauthors\thanks{The authors are with \paperaffiliation.}}
  \newcommand{\paperfront}{\maketitle\thispagestyle{empty}\pagestyle{empty}\paperabstract}
  \newcommand{\paperbibstyle}{IEEEtran}
}{\@ifclassloaded{elsarticle}{%
  \newcommand{\paperfront}{\begin{frontmatter}\title{\papertitle}\author{\paperauthors}
    \address{\paperaffiliation}\paperabstract\end{frontmatter}}   % \address, because \affiliation{organization=...} prints a trailing comma
  \newcommand{\paperbibstyle}{elsarticle-num}
}{\@ifclassloaded{llncs}{%
  \title{\papertitle}\author{\paperauthors}\institute{\paperaffiliation}
  \newcommand{\paperfront}{\maketitle\paperabstract}
  \newcommand{\paperbibstyle}{splncs04}
}{\@ifclassloaded{acmart}{%                          % the abstract comes before \maketitle
  \title{\papertitle}\author{\paperauthors}\affiliation{\institution{\paperaffiliation}\city{}\country{}}
  \@ifundefined{paperkeywords}{}{\keywords{\paperkeywords}}
  \@ifundefined{paperccs}{\ccsdesc[500]{Computer systems organization~Embedded and cyber-physical systems}}{\paperccs}   % CCS concept: set \paperccs to change it
  \newcommand{\paperfront}{\paperabstract\maketitle}
  \newcommand{\paperbibstyle}{ACM-Reference-Format}
}{%
  \title{\papertitle}\author{\paperauthors\\[2pt]\normalsize\paperaffiliation}\date{}
  \newcommand{\paperfront}{\maketitle\paperabstract}
  \newcommand{\paperbibstyle}{unsrt}
}}}}}

% Figure shapes (height/width) for two-column and one-column layouts: \autofig[aspect=\figaspect]{name}.
\newif\iftwocolumn \if@twocolumn \twocolumntrue \fi
\@ifclassloaded{acmart}{% acmart sets two columns only at \maketitle; two-column formats: acmtog, sigconf, siggraph, sigplan, sigchi, acmengage
  \ifcase\ACM@format@nr\or\or\or\twocolumntrue\or\twocolumntrue\or\twocolumntrue\or\twocolumntrue\or\twocolumntrue\or\or\twocolumntrue\fi}{}
\iftwocolumn \newcommand{\figaspect}{0.62}\newcommand{\wideaspect}{0.38}   % \figaspect: one column wide; \wideaspect: full text width
\else        \newcommand{\figaspect}{0.45}\newcommand{\wideaspect}{0.5}\fi
\makeatother
